lines.text: Same list as cigarettes? Most people hear: just as deadly.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪm lˈɪst az sˌɪɡəɹˈɛts? mˈəʊst pˈiːpəl hˈiə: dʒˈʌst az dˈɛdli.

lines.text: It's the World Health Organization's cancer agency: tanning beds sit in its top group, beside tobacco smoke. That group ranks how sure the evidence is, not how big the harm.
lines.phonemes: ɪts ðə wˈɜːld hˈɛlθ ˌɔːɡɐnaɪzˈeɪʃənz kˈansəɹ ˈeɪdʒənsi: tˈanɪŋ bˈɛdz sˈɪt ɪn ɪts tˈɒp ɡɹˈuːp, bɪsˌaɪd təbˈakəʊ smˈəʊk. ðat ɡɹˈuːp ɹˈaŋks hˌaʊ ʃˈʊə ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns ɪz, nˌɒt hˌaʊ bˈɪɡ ðə hˈɑːm.

lines.text: Follow the evidence into the bed: its light is mostly UVA, the long rays. In large, powerful units, it may be ten to fifteen times as intense as the midday sun.
lines.phonemes: fˈɒləʊ ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns ˌɪntʊ ðə bˈɛd: ɪts lˈaɪt ɪz mˈəʊstli jˌuːviːˈeɪ , ðə lˈɒŋ ɹˈeɪz. ɪn lˈɑːdʒ, pˈaʊəfəl jˈuːnɪts, ɪt mˈeɪ biː tˈɛn tə fˈɪftiːn tˈaɪmz az ɪntˈɛns az ðə mˌɪddˈeɪ sˈʌn.

lines.text: Weighing the studies, the agency's experts found the sharpest signal in people who started young. In pooled studies, starting before thirty-five went with a melanoma risk raised by more than half.
lines.phonemes: wˈeɪɪŋ ðə stˈʌdiz, ðɪ ˈeɪdʒənsiz ˈɛkspɜːts fˈaʊnd ðə ʃˈɑːpɪst sˈɪɡnəl ɪn pˈiːpəl hˌuː stˈɑːtɪd jˈʌŋ. ɪn pˈuːld stˈʌdiz, stˈɑːtɪŋ bɪfˌɔː θˈɜːtifˈaɪv wɛnt wɪð ˈeɪ mˌɛləˈnəʊmə ɹˈɪsk ɹˈeɪzd baɪ mˈɔː ðɐn hˈɑːf.

lines.text: Then whole countries acted: Brazil banned commercial tanning beds that same year; later, Australia switched its own off.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn hˈəʊl kˈʌntɹiz ˈaktɪd: bɹɐzˈɪl bˈand kəmˈɜːʃəl tˈanɪŋ bˈɛdz ðat sˈeɪm jˈiə; lˈeɪtə, ɒstɹˈeɪliə swˈɪtʃt ɪts ˈəʊn ˈɒf.

lines.text: And the long rays reach right through the top layer, on most skin about as thin as paper.
lines.phonemes: and ðə lˈɒŋ ɹˈeɪz ɹˈiːtʃ ɹˈaɪt θɹuː ðə tˈɒp lˈeɪə, ˌɒn mˈəʊst skˈɪn ɐbˌaʊt az θˈɪn az pˈeɪpə.

lines.text: Same list as cigarettes, then: not the same size of harm, but the same certainty.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪm lˈɪst az sˌɪɡəɹˈɛts, ðˈɛn: nˌɒt ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz ɒv hˈɑːm, bˌʌt ðə sˈeɪm sˈɜːtənti.

lines.text: Next season: why do bath fingers wrinkle, but never your arm?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst sˈiːzən: wˌaɪ dˈuː bˈaθ fˈɪŋɡəz ɹˈɪŋkəl, bˌʌt nˈɛvə jɔːɹ ˈɑːm?
